recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white portrait of a man in a leather jacket, positioned against a blurred urban street at night with prominent bokeh highlights. The composition features a central typographic stack framed by thin horizontal rules.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's leather texture vs. soft background bokeh
Centralized text block anchored to the subject's torso
High-contrast white lettering against dark jacket leather
Vertical subject orientation balanced by horizontal rules

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot, subject centered horizontally, looking over shoulder toward the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large central word of the typographic block.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subject's face, moves down to the central text, then follows the vertical stack of the name.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy bokeh on the left side provides breathing room for the subject's gaze.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and shadows in the jacket and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for typography and background bokeh highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays in the skin tones and pavement.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between text and background.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for secondary text
Heavy, condensed block forms for primary text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Weight contrast: Ultra-bold condensed paired with light wide-tracked geometric sans.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal rules (lines) above and below the text block

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, bold display text structure.
Matches the clean, geometric secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a black and white portrait of a man in a textured leather jacket, side profile looking at camera, standing on a city street at night. Use a shallow depth of field to create soft bokeh lights in the background. Apply a subtle film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a central text block. Place a thin white horizontal line. Below it, add a name in light sans-serif with wide tracking. Below that, add a large, bold, condensed word. Below that, add another name in light sans-serif with wide tracking. Finish with a second thin white horizontal line.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Is the central text block perfectly centered?
Are the horizontal rules thin and equal in length?

mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
Specific facial features of the original subject

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the subject's face

postGenerationChecks: Check for pure white text legibility against the jacket.
Ensure the horizontal rules do not touch the text.
Verify the bokeh does not distract from the subject's face.
Confirm the aspect ratio is square.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Portrait + Bokeh Background + [Condensed Bold Display Font] + [Wide-Tracked Light Sans-Serif] + Horizontal Rule Framing
